_readme: Round v7 (case C, model alone): one session, two fine-tunes of SFT v5 s1 (the best spaced model: select 62.0% alone, 94.9% word-level). GPU 0 = v7: balanced spelling drill (each of the 5,557 common words is the target 30 times on boards built only around training-side words; targets may be any common public word, disclosed) + half of the v5 teacher games as replay. GPU 1 = v7s: the strict ablation, where no dev or test answer is ever a drill target. Both are scored alone on select and heldout, alone under the labelled retry-3 rule, and, if alone beats the base model's 62% on select, with word-level decoding. GPU 1 first scores the base model under retry-3, as the baseline for that rule. Decision gate (ROADMAP): select alone >= 75% and word-level >= 93.8%.
